zh.title: 勞斯萊斯稱已有效消除AOG延誤 民航部門上半年營收成長29%
zh.summary: 勞斯萊斯表示，2026年上半年大型引擎維修產出增加13%、翻修量年增35%，已有效消除民航業務的飛機停飛（AOG）延誤。民航部門營收達61.9億英鎊、營業利益成長31%，公司並上修全年獲利預測。
body: 勞斯萊斯表示，在2026年上半年提升引擎維修與翻修工作量後，已有效消除其民航業務的飛機停飛（AOG）延誤。該公司將改善歸因於維修網路的調整及供應鏈穩定性的提升。
執行長Tufan Erginbilgic表示：「我們也已有效消除飛機停飛，為客戶提供顯著的營運效益。」AOG情況發生於航空公司因等待引擎、替換零件或維修工作而無法營運飛機時。
勞斯萊斯指出，截至2026年6月30日止六個月內，大型引擎維修產出增加13%，大型引擎翻修數量較上年同期成長35%。民航部門完成712次長期服務協議廠級維修，較上年的696次增加2%；主要大型引擎廠級維修則自217次增至294次。
該公司交付279具新民航引擎，成長18%，其中包括157具大型引擎及122具公務與區域航空引擎。在引擎耐久性方面，近半數Trent 1000 TEN機隊已升級高壓渦輪葉片至Trent 1000 XE標準，幾乎整個Trent 7000機隊亦已完成相同升級。
民航部門上半年營收成長29%至61.9億英鎊，營業利益增加31%至15.7億英鎊，營業利益率達25.3%。大型引擎飛行時數成長4%，達到2019年上半年水準的113%。
勞斯萊斯在上半年的業績表現後上修全年預測，目前預期基本營業利益介於47億至49億英鎊之間，高於先前預測的40億至42億英鎊。

en.title: Rolls-Royce Says It Has Effectively Eliminated AOG Delays; Civil Aerospace Revenue Rises 29%
en.summary: Rolls-Royce reported a 13% increase in large-engine maintenance output and a 35% rise in refurbishments during the first half of 2026, saying it has effectively eliminated aircraft-on-ground delays. Civil Aerospace revenue reached £6.19 billion and the company raised its full-year profit forecast.
body: Rolls-Royce said it has effectively eliminated aircraft-on-ground (AOG) delays in its civil aerospace business after increasing engine maintenance and refurbishment work during the first half of 2026. The company linked the improvement to changes across its maintenance network and greater stability in its supply chain.

CEO Tufan Erginbilgic stated: "We have also effectively eliminated aircraft on ground, providing a significant operational benefit to our customers." An AOG case occurs when an airline cannot operate an aircraft because it is waiting for an engine, replacement part or maintenance work.

Rolls-Royce increased large-engine maintenance output by 13% during the six months ending June 30, 2026, while the number of large-engine refurbishments rose 35% from a year earlier. The Civil Aerospace unit completed 712 long-term service agreement shop visits, up 2% from 696, and major large-engine shop visits increased to 294 from 217.

The company delivered 279 new civil engines, up 18%, including 157 large engines and 122 engines for business and regional aircraft. On durability, nearly half of the Trent 1000 TEN fleet has received upgraded high-pressure turbine blades bringing those engines to the Trent 1000 XE standard, and nearly the entire Trent 7000 fleet has received the same upgrade.

Civil Aerospace revenue rose 29% to £6.19 billion during the first half, with operating profit increasing 31% to £1.57 billion and the operating margin reaching 25.3%. Large-engine flying hours increased 4%, reaching 113% of the level recorded in the first half of 2019.

Rolls-Royce raised its full-year forecast following the first-half results, now expecting underlying operating profit of between £4.7 billion and £4.9 billion, up from its previous forecast of £4 billion to £4.2 billion.
